label: tp-extreme-10y
_why: STAGE 1 OF THE TREATY-PORT DESIRE PROBES (user, 2026-10-18: 'Go with two 10-year probes with extreme values to ensure that countries attempt to create treaty ports all over the place'). The book under test is the next-arm book (the canon + WORLD_MARKET_MONOPOLY_THRESHOLD 0.99, user-chosen base) + ai_treaty_ports with the EXTREME table: +400 to every eligible target, cap 1,000, everything else the production design (trade-law terms, population, port-state quality, conquest-stance x0, protectorate-feasible x0.25, existing-port x0.5, technology parity cancel at a lead of 5 or less). The question is mechanical, not balance: does the engine read treaty_port_value from an ADMINISTRATIVE strategy at all, and does a high value turn into treaty-port war goals (in 1.13 an enforce_treaty_article goal with article treaty_port, FINDINGS F243) and treaty ports in force? Today: 1 of 2,029 active war goals.

_arms.tpx: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99-tpx.json} - the next-arm book + ai_treaty_ports (EXTREME) + telemetry. Built from the current tree, so it also carries the 2026-10-18 isolationism fix (0b7b2ad).

_comparison: Against the war-goal census of F243 (vanilla n=16 endpoints 0 treaty-port goals of 614; 12 canon-family endpoints 1 of 482; the user's Qing playtest 0 of 933) and the 1836 treaty ports (Macau, Singapore, Bandar Abbas only). Read with the v19 save summaries (world.war_goals, world.treaty_port_goals, world.treaty_ports) and tools/testbed/ledger/war_goal_mix.mjs on any kept save.

_predictions.if the engine reads the block: treaty-port goals (enforce_treaty_article:treaty_port) in most yearly snapshots from the first years, held by many different countries against many targets; new treaty ports in force by 1846 well beyond the three historical ones
_predictions.if it does not: treaty-port goals and treaty ports at vanilla's rates (0-1 goals a snapshot, the 1836 ports only) - then the block moves to the diplomatic strategies
_predictions.the parity cancel: no treaty-port goal held against a target whose technology count is within 5 of the holder's or above it (checked per goal from the summaries' technology counts)
_predictions.load check: error.log carries no line naming treaty_port_value, pmr_tp_tech_lead or 01_admin_strategies

_stop_rule: none: two fixed runs (a mechanism probe, read in full).
_caveats: EXTREME values: the economy and the wars of these runs are not a balance reading of anything.
